features.name: total_cost_score
features.description: Sum of buying and maintenance costs to represent the overall economic burden of the vehicle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single continuous split point for tree models to evaluate total cost rather than splitting on buying and maint separately.

features.name: total_capacity_score
features.description: Sum of doors, persons, and luggage boot size to represent the overall utility and capacity of the vehicle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates physical capacity attributes into a single ordinal feature, allowing trees to easily isolate high-utility vehicles.

features.name: is_high_safety
features.description: Boolean indicator for vehicles with the highest safety rating.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct binary split for top-tier safety, which is often a critical decision boundary.

features.name: is_low_safety
features.description: Boolean indicator for vehicles with the lowest safety rating.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct binary split for poor safety, allowing the model to quickly filter out unviable options.

features.name: cost_to_capacity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total cost to total capacity, representing the price per unit of utility.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a nonlinear interaction between cost and utility that tree models cannot easily synthesize on their own.

features.name: family_car_suitability
features.description: Boolean indicator for vehicles that meet minimum requirements for a family car (adequate persons capacity, doors, and safety).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a pre-computed logical AND condition, saving the tree from needing multiple deep splits to identify family-appropriate vehicles.

features.name: luxury_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for vehicles with high buying cost, high maintenance, and high safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups high-end vehicles into a single category, helping the model identify premium segments efficiently.

features.name: practicality_index
features.description: Weighted sum of utility features, giving extra importance to luggage boot size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers an alternative ordinal ranking of utility that prioritizes cargo space, providing a different perspective for tree splits.

features.name: semantic_safety_assessment
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the vehicle's overall safety and reliability profile, considering the safety rating and maintenance level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced semantic relationships between maintenance quality and safety ratings that simple arithmetic might miss.

features.name: semantic_value_proposition
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the vehicle's value proposition based on the trade-off between cost (buying, maint) and utility (doors, persons, lug_boot).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, human-like assessment of whether the vehicle is 'worth it', giving the tree a powerful high-level feature to split on.

features.name: capacity_safety_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between passenger capacity and safety rating.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the critical combination of carrying many people and keeping them safe, which is a strong nonlinear signal.

features.name: overall_quality_score
features.description: A composite score rewarding safety, capacity, and luggage space while penalizing buying and maintenance costs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a single, strong monotonic feature that aligns with general vehicle desirability, reducing the depth required for the tree to make accurate predictions.
